unsupportedPlatform.title: GitHub repositories only, for now
unsupportedPlatform.body: This workspace's remote is on {{host}}. Continuous issue fixing currently reads issues and tracks pull requests through GitHub; support for other code hosts is planned.

readiness.loopxMissing: The LoopX engine is unavailable, so continuous fixing cannot run. Reinstalling BitFun restores the bundled engine; developers can also `pip install -e <loopx>` and set LOOPX_BIN.
readiness.ghMissing: GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed. The fix agent reads issues and publishes pull requests through gh — install it from https://cli.github.com and restart BitFun.
readiness.ghUnauthenticated: GitHub CLI is not signed in. Run `gh auth login` in a terminal, then refresh this panel.
